title: Symbolic powers are preserved by a flat extension along which the prime stays prime
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a flat ring map R to S and a prime p whose extension q is prime, the lemma states that the extension of the n-th symbolic power of p is the n-th symbolic power of q (statement lines 15794-15799). The proof does not compare primary decompositions: it rewrites both symbolic powers as kernels of maps to localised quotients, reduces to injectivity of the localised comparison, and then obtains that injectivity from the existence of a filtration whose subquotients are tensor products of a vector space with the localised residue ring, which makes elements outside q act invertibly (proof lines 15801-15829). Producing that filtration from flatness is the step carrying the argument. H2.
